action.label: Buy or sell
action.meaning: Whether the leg is bought or sold.

active.label: Active
active.meaning: Whether the ticker is still tracked. Inactive tickers keep their history but get no new data.

adv_usd_20d.label: Normal day's trading
adv_usd_20d.meaning: The average dollar value traded per day over the last 20 trading days.

alpha_annualized.label: Return beyond the market, per year
alpha_annualized.meaning: The book's yearly return left over once the part explained by the market is removed — the part the signal earned.
alpha_annualized.read: Only meaningful beside its error band. A figure inside its own error band cannot be told from zero.

alpha_daily.label: Return beyond the market, per day
alpha_daily.meaning: The book's average daily return left over once the part explained by the market is removed.

alpha_std_error_annualized.label: Error band on that
alpha_std_error_annualized.meaning: How uncertain the yearly alpha estimate is. Roughly two of these either side of the estimate is the plausible range.

alpha_t_stat.label: Signal strength
alpha_t_stat.meaning: The alpha divided by its error band.
alpha_t_stat.read: Beyond about ±2 the result is distinguishable from luck; inside it, it is not.

annualized_cost_drag.label: Yearly cost of trading
annualized_cost_drag.meaning: How much return trading costs take away per year.

annualized_gross_return.label: Yearly return before costs
annualized_gross_return.meaning: The yearly return before trading costs are taken off.

annualized_return.label: Yearly return
annualized_return.meaning: The total return scaled to a one-year rate.
annualized_return.read: Over short periods this exaggerates — a few weeks scaled up to a year is not a rate anything has sustained.

annualized_volatility.label: Yearly swings
annualized_volatility.meaning: How much the book's value moves around, as a yearly standard deviation.

article.label: Wikipedia article
article.meaning: The article whose page views stand for public attention to the company.

as_of.label: As of
as_of.meaning: The newest day the figures cover.

ask.label: Ask
ask.meaning: The lowest price a seller is asking, per share. Buying costs you the ask.

asset_type.label: Kind
asset_type.meaning: Whether the ticker is a company's stock or a fund (ETF) that holds many stocks.

atm_days.label: Days to that option's expiry
atm_days.meaning: Calendar days until expiry for the option used for the headline implied volatility.

atm_iv.label: Priced-in swings, near the price
atm_iv.meaning: Implied volatility of the option closest to the current price, about a month out — the market's headline volatility estimate for the stock.

attention_ratio.label: Attention vs usual
attention_ratio.meaning: The past week's views divided by the usual level.
attention_ratio.read: 1 is normal. This page calls 3 or more unusual. Attention tends to rise with a big move rather than before it.

available.label: Available
available.meaning: Whether an illustration could be built — it needs a strong enough forecast and enough quoted strikes.

avg_daily_return.label: Average daily return
avg_daily_return.meaning: The mean gain or loss per trading day.

avg_iv.label: Average priced-in swings
avg_iv.meaning: The mean implied volatility across the contracts in the group.

avg_next_day_return.label: Average next-day return
avg_next_day_return.meaning: How the stocks in that forecast group did on the following day, on average.
avg_next_day_return.read: If the ranking works, group 1 should do best and group 5 worst.

baseline_90d.label: Usual views a day
baseline_90d.meaning: The middle value of daily page views over the 90 days before that week.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.meaning: The index fund the market's results are compared with — SPY for the NYSE, STX40.JO for the JSE.

benchmark_equity.label: Index fund value
benchmark_equity.meaning: What buying the market's index fund and holding it would be worth, on the same scale as the book.

beta.label: Moves with the market
beta.meaning: How much the book tends to move when the market's index moves 1%.
beta.read: 0 means it does not follow the market at all, which is the design here; 1 means it moves one-for-one.

bid.label: Bid
bid.meaning: The highest price a buyer is offering, per share. Selling gets you the bid.

books.label: Books
books.meaning: One entry per version of the paper book.

breakeven.label: Breakeven price
breakeven.meaning: The stock price at expiry where the structure neither gains nor loses.

call_gamma_near_share.label: Call hedging expiring within a month
call_gamma_near_share.meaning: The share of the call hedging exposure in contracts that expire within 30 days, where it is most concentrated.

call_gamma_share_of_adv.label: Call hedging vs normal trading
call_gamma_share_of_adv.meaning: The call hedging per 1% move, as a share of a normal day's dollar trading.
call_gamma_share_of_adv.read: Higher means hedging could move the price more.

call_gamma_usd_1pct.label: Call hedging per 1% move
call_gamma_usd_1pct.meaning: The stock a dealer would buy per 1% rise if dealers had sold every listed call — the gamma-squeeze channel.
call_gamma_usd_1pct.read: An upper bound. Public data does not show who holds which side.

call_oi.label: Call contracts open
call_oi.meaning: How many call contracts are open on the stock.

champions.label: Champions
champions.meaning: One entry per model that has served as champion, with its live record.

close.label: Close
close.meaning: The last traded price of the day, adjusted for dividends and splits.

code.label: Market code
code.meaning: The exchange's standard four-letter code, such as XNYS or XJSE.

cohorts.label: Cohorts
cohorts.meaning: One entry per group of spreads opened on the same day.

conditions.label: Reopen conditions
conditions.meaning: The checks that would bring the decision back for review, each evaluated on the current record.

configured.label: Configured
configured.meaning: Whether the market is set up in the configuration file.

contracts.label: Contracts
contracts.meaning: One entry per option contract in the chain.

correlation.label: Moves together with the market
correlation.meaning: How closely the book's daily moves line up with the market's, from -1 to 1.

currency.label: Currency
currency.meaning: The currency prices are quoted in.

daily_return.label: Daily return
daily_return.meaning: The book's gain or loss that day, after costs.

database.label: Database reachable
database.meaning: Whether the service could read the database.

date.label: Date
date.meaning: The trading day the figures are for.

days_to_cover.label: Days to buy back
days_to_cover.meaning: Shares sold short divided by average daily volume — how many days of normal trading it would take every short seller to buy back.
days_to_cover.read: Higher means a rush to buy back would move the price more.

days_to_expiry.label: Days left
days_to_expiry.meaning: Calendar days until the option expires.

decision.label: Decision
decision.meaning: What the promotion gate decided about a candidate model — promoted to champion, or rejected.

decisions.label: Standing decisions
decisions.meaning: Decisions already taken, each with the conditions named in advance that would reopen it.

delta.label: Share-equivalent
delta.meaning: How much the option's price moves for a $1 move in the stock — roughly how many shares, per share of the contract, it behaves like.
delta.read: Calls 0 to 1, puts -1 to 0. Near ±0.5 is at the money.

detail.label: Detail
detail.meaning: The figures behind the item's state, in words.

direction.label: View
direction.meaning: Bullish expects a rise, bearish a fall, neutral no clear view.

display_divisor.label: Price divisor
display_divisor.meaning: What stored prices are divided by before display. The JSE stores prices in cents, so its divisor is 100.

display_symbol.label: Currency symbol
display_symbol.meaning: The symbol shown in front of prices for this market.

drawdown.label: Below the high
drawdown.meaning: How far the book sits below its highest value so far.

drifted.label: Drifted
drifted.meaning: Whether this input's shift from training is above 0.20.

entry_debit.label: Cost to open
entry_debit.meaning: What the spread cost per share — the bought option at its ask, less the sold option at its bid. A contract is 100 shares.

equity.label: Book value
equity.meaning: The paper book's value, starting at 1.0. 1.10 means it is up 10%.

exchange.label: Market
exchange.meaning: Which stock exchange the figures belong to. XNYS is the New York Stock Exchange, XJSE the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

exit_date.label: Closed
exit_date.meaning: The day the spreads were sold — the share book's next rebalance. Empty while still open.

expiries.label: Expiries
expiries.meaning: The expiry dates captured for the stock.

expiry.label: Expiry
expiry.meaning: The last day the option can be used. After it, the option is worth only what it pays out.

feature.label: Model input
feature.meaning: One of the 13 measurements the model reads for each stock each day.

features.label: Model inputs
features.meaning: One entry per model input, with its shift from training.

findings.label: Findings
findings.meaning: Measurements this project has made, each with its question and what came back.

gamma.label: How fast that changes
gamma.meaning: How much the delta changes for a $1 move in the stock.
gamma.read: Highest near the strike and close to expiry — where hedgers must trade the most.

has_options.label: Has option data
has_options.meaning: Whether free option chains exist for this market. Only the NYSE has them.

high.label: High
high.meaning: The highest traded price of the day.

holdout_ic.label: Ranking accuracy
holdout_ic.meaning: How closely the model's ordering of stocks matched the order they actually performed in, measured on recent data it was not trained on (a rank correlation).
holdout_ic.read: 0 is no better than chance and 1 is perfect. For ranking stocks a month ahead, around 0.05 is already useful.

holdout_max_drawdown.label: Worst fall, test period
holdout_max_drawdown.meaning: The largest peak-to-trough loss of that paper book over the test period.

holdout_sharpe.label: Return per unit of risk, test period
holdout_sharpe.meaning: The Sharpe ratio a paper book following the model earned on the test period.
holdout_sharpe.read: Higher is better; below 0 lost money.

horizon_equity.label: Monthly-rebalanced book value
horizon_equity.meaning: The same signal traded only every 21 days instead of daily, on the same scale.

implied.label: Priced-in swings
implied.meaning: What option prices assumed about the stock's movement over the next month, averaged across stocks.

implied_volatility.label: Priced-in swings
implied_volatility.meaning: How much movement the option's price assumes, as a yearly percentage.
implied_volatility.read: Higher means the market expects bigger moves, which makes options dearer.

in_the_money.label: Worth exercising now
in_the_money.meaning: Whether exercising the option right now would pay something — a call when the price is above the strike, a put when below.

information_ratio.label: Return over the index per unit of difference
information_ratio.meaning: The book's return above the index, divided by how differently it moves.
information_ratio.read: A market-neutral book scores badly on this by construction while the index rises; read alpha instead.

is_current.label: Current champion
is_current.meaning: Whether this model is the one currently making the forecasts.

last_price.label: Last traded price
last_price.meaning: The price of the most recent trade in the contract.

latest_feature_date.label: Model inputs up to
latest_feature_date.meaning: The newest trading day with computed model inputs.

latest_prediction_date.label: Forecasts up to
latest_prediction_date.meaning: The newest trading day with model forecasts.

latest_price_date.label: Prices up to
latest_price_date.meaning: The newest trading day with prices.

latest_score.label: Latest forecast
latest_score.meaning: The model's most recent predicted 21-day return for the stock.

latest_snapshot_date.label: Latest options capture
latest_snapshot_date.meaning: The newest day with captured option prices.

legs.label: Legs
legs.meaning: The individual contracts the structure is made of.

live_since.label: Live since
live_since.meaning: The day the market's first champion model was promoted. Everything from here is genuinely out-of-sample.

live_window.label: Live window
live_window.meaning: The first and last trading day of the live record.

long_strike.label: Bought strike
long_strike.meaning: The strike of the option bought, nearest the stock's price when the spread opened.

low.label: Low
low.meaning: The lowest traded price of the day.

ma_ratio_21.label: Price vs its 1-month average
ma_ratio_21.meaning: How far the price sits above or below its average over the last 21 trading days.

ma_ratio_21_cs_rank.label: Price vs 1-month average, ranked
ma_ratio_21_cs_rank.meaning: Where the stock's distance from its 1-month average ranks among all stocks in its market that day, from 0 to 1.

ma_ratio_63.label: Price vs its 3-month average
ma_ratio_63.meaning: How far the price sits above or below its average over the last 63 trading days.

mark_basis.label: Valued from
mark_basis.meaning: Quote means that day's bid and ask. Last quote means one option's quote that day was missing or unreliable (no bid, or far too wide), so its last sound quote stands in. Intrinsic means no sound quote was ever seen, so it is valued at what it would pay out now. Settled means it expired.

mark_date.label: Valued on
mark_date.meaning: The day the value was taken.

mark_value.label: Value now
mark_value.meaning: What closing the spread would raise per share — the bought option at its bid, less buying back the sold one at its ask.

max_drawdown.label: Worst fall
max_drawdown.meaning: The largest drop from a high point to a later low, as a share of the high.

max_loss.label: Most it can lose
max_loss.meaning: The largest loss per share. For a debit spread this is what it cost.

max_profit.label: Most it can make
max_profit.meaning: The largest gain per share, if the stock moves past the sold strike by expiry.

mean_turnover.label: Average share traded per day
mean_turnover.meaning: How much of the book is replaced on an average day.

memory_limit_bytes.label: Memory limit
memory_limit_bytes.meaning: The most memory the service is allowed, in bytes.

memory_rss_bytes.label: Memory in use
memory_rss_bytes.meaning: How much memory the service is using, in bytes.

metrics.label: Measurements
metrics.meaning: The candidate's scores on the data it was tested on, such as ranking accuracy and Sharpe ratio.

mid.label: Midpoint price
mid.meaning: Halfway between the bid and the ask — a fair-value estimate. Real trades pay more to buy and get less to sell.

mlflow_run_id.label: Experiment record
mlflow_run_id.meaning: The training run's identifier in MLflow, the experiment tracker, where its full details are kept.

model_version.label: Model version
model_version.meaning: Which trained model made the forecast. Each retraining that passes the gate gets a new version number.

mom_63.label: Past 3 months' return
mom_63.meaning: The stock's change over the last 63 trading days.

mom_63_cs_rank.label: Past 3 months' return, ranked
mom_63_cs_rank.meaning: Where the stock's past-3-month return ranks among all stocks in its market that day, from 0 to 1.

n_contracts.label: Contracts captured
n_contracts.meaning: How many option contracts were recorded for the stock in the snapshot.

n_days.label: Trading days
n_days.meaning: How many trading days the figures cover.

net_debit.label: Cost to open
net_debit.meaning: What the structure costs per share — the bought leg less the sold leg. A contract is 100 shares.

note.label: Note
note.meaning: A remark recorded with the item.

open.label: Open
open.meaning: The first traded price of the day.

open_interest.label: Contracts open
open_interest.meaning: How many contracts exist and have not yet been closed or exercised.

opened.label: Opened
opened.meaning: The day the spreads were bought — a rebalance day of the monthly share book.

option_type.label: Call or put
option_type.meaning: A call is the right to buy 100 shares at the strike price before expiry; a put is the right to sell them.

options_return.label: Options book return
options_return.meaning: What the cohort's spreads made or lost, as a share of the options book's value when they were bought.
options_return.read: Each cohort risks a fixed tenth of the book, so this scales with that choice; compare return on premium too.

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.meaning: What the evidence showed, including results later withdrawn.

overall.label: All days
overall.meaning: The figures over the whole history.

phase.label: Phase
phase.meaning: Replay means figures from before the model went live, which it may have been fitted on — a description of the fit, not evidence. Live means genuinely out-of-sample.

phases.label: Phases
phases.meaning: One entry per phase — the replay and the live record.

positions.label: Spreads
positions.meaning: One entry per name in the newest cohort, including any that could not be traded.

premium.label: Priced-in minus actual
premium.meaning: Implied volatility less what then happened, in percentage points.
premium.read: Positive means options were priced for more movement than arrived.

price.label: Price
price.meaning: The leg's price per share, at the midpoint where quotable. A contract is 100 shares.

psi.label: Shift from training
psi.meaning: How far this input's recent values have moved away from the values the model was trained on.
psi.read: Under 0.10 is no real change, 0.10–0.20 a moderate shift, above 0.20 counts as drifted.

psi_threshold.label: Alarm level per input
psi_threshold.meaning: The shift from training above which one model input counts as drifted.

put_call_ratio.label: Puts per call
put_call_ratio.meaning: Open put contracts divided by open call contracts.
put_call_ratio.read: Above 1 means more protection or bearish bets than bullish ones.

put_gamma_share_of_adv.label: Put hedging vs normal trading
put_gamma_share_of_adv.meaning: The put hedging per 1% move, as a share of a normal day's dollar trading.

put_gamma_usd_1pct.label: Put hedging per 1% move
put_gamma_usd_1pct.meaning: The stock a dealer would sell per 1% fall if dealers had sold every listed put.
put_gamma_usd_1pct.read: An upper bound, for the same reason.

put_oi.label: Put contracts open
put_oi.meaning: How many put contracts are open on the stock.

question.label: Question
question.meaning: What the investigation set out to answer.

r_squared.label: Share explained by the market
r_squared.meaning: How much of the book's ups and downs the market's moves account for.
r_squared.read: Near 0 means the book's moves are its own.

rank.label: Rank
rank.meaning: The stock's position when every stock in the market is sorted by the model's forecast. 1 is the strongest.

rationale.label: Why
rationale.meaning: How the model's forecast maps to the structure, in words.

realized.label: Swings that then happened
realized.meaning: How much the stocks actually moved over the 21 trading days that followed, on the same yearly scale.

rebalance_days.label: Trades every
rebalance_days.meaning: How many trading days the book holds its positions before re-forming them.

recent.label: Recent days
recent.meaning: The figures over roughly the last 30 trading days.

ret_1.label: Yesterday's return
ret_1.meaning: The stock's change over the last trading day.

ret_21.label: Past month's return
ret_21.meaning: The stock's change over the last 21 trading days.

ret_21_cs_rank.label: Past month's return, ranked
ret_21_cs_rank.meaning: Where the stock's past-month return ranks among all stocks in its market that day, from 0 to 1.

ret_5.label: Past week's return
ret_5.meaning: The stock's change over the last 5 trading days.

ret_5_cs_rank.label: Past week's return, ranked
ret_5_cs_rank.meaning: Where the stock's past-week return ranks among all stocks in its market that day, from 0 to 1.

return_on_premium.label: Return on what was paid
return_on_premium.meaning: What a spread made or lost, as a share of what it cost to open, commissions included.
return_on_premium.read: -100% is the most a spread can lose. It does not depend on how much of the book was risked.

risk_budget.label: Risked per cohort
risk_budget.meaning: The share of the options book's value each cohort spends on its spreads — the most a cohort can lose.

rolling_sharpe_63d.label: Return per unit of risk, past 3 months
rolling_sharpe_63d.meaning: The Sharpe ratio over the most recent 63 trading days, recomputed each day.

run_id.label: Run
run_id.meaning: The failed run's identifier in Dagster, the scheduler.

run_type.label: Run type
run_type.meaning: What the training run was — a candidate (train), a promotion, a demotion, or a shadow fitted only for comparison.

score.label: Model's forecast, next month
score.meaning: The return the model predicts for the stock over the next 21 trading days (about a month). Only the ranking across stocks is used — the top ones are bought and the bottom ones sold short on paper.
score.read: Higher means the model expects the stock to do better than the others. It is a research output, not advice.

share_drifted.label: Inputs drifted
share_drifted.meaning: The share of the 13 model inputs whose shift from training is above 0.20.
share_drifted.read: At 30% or more, the model is retrained early.

share_equity.label: Monthly share book value
share_equity.meaning: The monthly-rebalanced share book's value on the same scale as the options book, both starting at 1.0 on the options book's first day.

share_threshold.label: Alarm level overall
share_threshold.meaning: The share of model inputs that must drift before the model is retrained early.

shares_return.label: Same names held as shares
shares_return.meaning: What the monthly share book, holding the same stocks over the same window, made or lost.

shares_short.label: Shares sold short
shares_short.meaning: Shares borrowed and sold, not yet bought back. Short sellers lose as the price rises.

sharpe.label: Return per unit of risk
sharpe.meaning: Yearly return divided by yearly swings. It says how much return the book earned for the ups and downs it went through.
sharpe.read: Above 1 is good, around 0 means no reward for the risk, below 0 lost money. Withheld under 20 trading days, where it is noise.

short_change.label: Change since previous report
short_change.meaning: How shares sold short changed since the previous settlement report.

short_known_from.label: Short interest known from
short_known_from.meaning: When the short-interest figure first became available here.

short_pct_float.label: Short, share of tradable shares
short_pct_float.meaning: Shares sold short as a share of the shares available to trade.
short_pct_float.read: 10–20% is commonly called elevated and 20% or more high. GameStop's was above 100% in January 2021.

short_settlement_date.label: Short interest settled
short_settlement_date.meaning: The date the short-interest figure describes. It is published a week or two later.

short_strike.label: Sold strike
short_strike.meaning: The strike of the option sold, about 10% further out, which caps both the cost and the payoff.

side.label: Side
side.meaning: Long means bought, expecting a rise. Short means sold borrowed shares, expecting a fall.

signal.label: Model's forecast, next month
signal.meaning: The model's predicted return for this stock over the next 21 trading days.
signal.read: Higher means the model expects the stock to do better than the others.

signal_quintile.label: Forecast group
signal_quintile.meaning: Each day the stocks are split into five equal groups by the model's forecast. 1 holds the strongest forecasts, 5 the weakest.

skipped.label: Could not trade
skipped.meaning: Names the share book held that the options book could not, each with the reason.

snapshot_date.label: Captured on
snapshot_date.meaning: The trading day whose after-close option prices were recorded.

spot.label: Stock price
spot.meaning: The stock's price when the option chain was captured, after the close.

spreads.label: Spreads
spreads.meaning: How many option spreads the cohort holds.

state.label: State
state.meaning: For a decision — standing, reopened (a condition was met), watched elsewhere, or can't be checked here. For a condition — armed, fired or unknown.

status.label: Status
status.meaning: The item's state. For the service, whether it is working; for an options-book spread, open, closed, or skipped because it could not be traded.

strike.label: Strike price
strike.meaning: The price at which the option lets its holder buy (call) or sell (put) the stock.

strikes.label: Strikes
strikes.meaning: One entry per strike price, with the hedging exposure at it.

structure.label: Structure
structure.meaning: The kind of option position, such as a bull call spread.

term_structure.label: Priced-in swings by expiry
term_structure.meaning: Implied volatility for each expiry, near to far.

theo_value.label: Model price
theo_value.meaning: The option's value from the Black-Scholes formula using its implied volatility.

theta.label: Daily time decay
theta.meaning: How much value the option loses per day as expiry approaches, all else equal.

ticker.label: Ticker
ticker.meaning: The stock's symbol on its exchange. JSE symbols end in .JO.

tickers.label: Stocks
tickers.meaning: How many stocks the day's average covers.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.meaning: The exchange's local time zone, which decides when its trading day ends.

title.label: Title
title.meaning: A short name for the item.

total_return.label: Total return
total_return.meaning: The book's gain or loss over the whole period.

tracking_error.label: Difference from the market
tracking_error.meaning: How much the book's return differs from the index's, as a yearly standard deviation.

turnover.label: Share traded
turnover.meaning: How much of the book was bought or sold that day, as a share of its value.

type.label: Check
type.meaning: Which kind of check the condition is.

underlying_close.label: Stock price
underlying_close.meaning: The closing price of the stock an option is written on, on the snapshot day.

url.label: Link
url.meaning: Where to read the full write-up.

variant.label: Book
variant.meaning: Which version of the paper book — daily rebalancing, monthly rebalancing, or long only. Each differs from the daily book in exactly one way.

vega.label: Sensitivity to priced-in swings
vega.meaning: How much the option's price changes for a 1-point change in implied volatility.

views.label: Page views
views.meaning: How many times the company's Wikipedia article was read that day.

views_7d.label: Views a day, past week
views_7d.meaning: The average daily page views over the last 7 days.

vol_21.label: Past month's swings
vol_21.meaning: How much the stock's daily returns varied over the last 21 trading days.

vol_63.label: Past 3 months' swings
vol_63.meaning: How much the stock's daily returns varied over the last 63 trading days.

volume.label: Volume
volume.meaning: How many shares (or option contracts) traded that day.

volume_z_21.label: Trading activity vs usual
volume_z_21.meaning: How unusual today's trading volume is compared with the last 21 days.

weight.label: Share of the book
weight.meaning: How much of the book's value sits in this position. Negative means a short sale.

win_rate.label: Days up
win_rate.meaning: The share of trading days the book made money.
win_rate.read: Above 50% means more up days than down, though not necessarily more money.

window.label: Served as champion
window.meaning: The days this model was the champion making the live forecasts.
